subject: Staff-managed public content for JAE
body:
Hello JAE corporate team,

I saw JAE's public information covers manufacturing, engineering and major refurbishment for the mining industry.

I'm Ramish, founder of Nexora. We've built a modular platform whose website CMS lets staff draft, preview and publish branded information pages. A focused evaluation could use three sample service, project-information and news pages with one editor before considering a wider scope. This would cover public content, with your operational systems outside the evaluation.

I've attached a 90-second narrated introduction to Nexora's wider membership platform, with captions. A CMS walkthrough would focus specifically on editing and publishing.

Would a 15-minute website-editor walkthrough be useful for your corporate service and project information?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com
